terms.E_act_raw: per-replica uncensored BEP methane activation barrier, floored at zero because a physical forward barrier cannot be negative
terms.-2*dE_H + mu_H2: free-energy cost to release two adsorbed H atoms as ideal-gas H2 at the condition temperature and 1 bar
terms.-dE_C: thermodynamic cost to release adsorbed C into the solid-carbon reference state

standard_state: H2 ideal gas at 1 bar; NIST Shomate H2 coefficients over 298-2500 K and H(298.15)-H(0)=8.468 kJ/mol
scope_gate: Pure p-block molten hosts are unscorable until an independently validated host-specific activation model exists.
evidence_boundary: A parameter-free rate average over five idealized GNN alloy configurations; it does not represent liquid hydrodynamics, equilibrium liquid disorder, off-site carbon nucleation, or a transition-state calculation.
